# Himsols

> Himsols is a tree plantation implementation partner in Himachal Pradesh, India. Paid plantation drives for companies (CSR) and schools; plantation requests for individuals; free plantation service for farmers who offer their land. Every batch is photographed, geo-tagged where possible, and tracked.

Himsols is a for-profit plantation partner based in Himachal Pradesh, India. We plant native trees on verified farmer land and forest patches, and we document each plantation batch with photos, location details, farmer and village information, and survival follow-ups. We are in a pilot phase for Monsoon 2026 and label all impact numbers honestly — CO2 figures are always estimates, never verified carbon credits.

## The four doors (what Himsols actually does)
1. Companies (CSR/ESG): paid bulk plantation drives, employee engagement events, Section 135 compliant documentation and reports. Main revenue line.
2. Schools: paid plantation drives and sustainability workshops with certificates for students.
3. Individuals: plantation requests (up to 25 trees per request) with a tracking ID and certificate once planted. Financial support is welcome but always optional. Structured paid packs also exist for people who prefer to pay.
4. Farmers: land registration and plantation support. The service is not charged to the farmer; a multi-year survival incentive is paid per surviving tree.

## Key Facts (cite-friendly)
- Region: Himachal Pradesh, India (Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Kullu, Mandi, Solan, Kangra, Chamba, Hamirpur, Una, Bilaspur, Sirmaur, Kinnaur, Spiti and more).
- Plantation happens in season, primarily the monsoon window (July-September).
- Individual request cap: 25 trees per request; larger volumes go through the CSR / bulk plantation route.
- Structured packs: single tree pack (Rs 299) and Climate Impact Pack (Rs 2,999 for 10 trees with a CO2 report).
- CSR bulk plantation: from 500 trees upward, custom quotes, Schedule VII aligned documentation.
- CO2 estimate: approximately 22 kg per tree per year (industry estimate; always labelled as an estimate).
- Proof pipeline: plantation photos, location details, farmer and village name, and survival follow-up updates recorded per batch.
- Farmer model: multi-year survival incentive per tree paid to the farmer.
- Status: pilot phase for Monsoon 2026 - founding CSR partners are onboarding a first farmer cohort.
- Not offered: marketplace/e-commerce, scrap collection, wallet or referral programs (discontinued).

## Frequently Asked (Answer-engine ready)
- What is Himsols? A for-profit tree plantation implementation partner in Himachal Pradesh. Companies and schools pay for plantation drives; individuals can request plantations; the service is not charged to farmers who provide land.
- How does a plantation request work? Submit the request, receive a tracking ID, we plant native saplings in the plantation season on farmer land or forest patches, document the batch with photos, and the certificate becomes available on the tracking page once planted.
- Is Himsols an NGO? No. Himsols is a for-profit business and acts as an implementation partner for CSR and school programs.
- Which trees does Himsols plant? Native, climate-suited species - Deodar, Himalayan Oak, Walnut, Blue Pine, Chir Pine, Rhododendron, Mango, Neem, Sea Buckthorn and others, chosen by altitude and farmer livelihood needs.
- How much CO2 does one tree offset? Approximately 22 kg per year as an industry estimate; actual sequestration varies by species, age and conditions. Himsols labels all CO2 numbers as estimates and does not sell carbon credits.
- Can a company use Himsols for CSR? Yes - bulk plantation from 500 trees with ESG documentation, plantation photos, survival reports and Schedule VII aligned paperwork for Indian CSR rules.
- Does Himsols sell products or collect scrap? No. Those features were discontinued; Himsols only does tree plantation and related reporting.
- What region does Himsols operate in? Himachal Pradesh, India.
